final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), status_shares AS (SELECT status, project_count, 1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts) SELECT status, project_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM status_shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM status_shares)
